module: Hidden node "GHOST" (category logic, hidden=true). Serves as a replacement when a flowgraph project references a node type that no longer exists: it keeps the original data (ghostData) so it is not lost on save, displays the original type and marks an error "Node ... doesn't exist!". Does nothing at runtime.
notes: The displayed name is built with the %a+ pattern, so it keeps only the last group of letters of the type (digits split the word).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the original node type and a "Dump ghost data" button that prints ghostData to the console.

__onSerialize.desc: Returns the original data (ghostData) as is so that the node is saved again identically.

_onDeserialized.desc: Records the error, stores the original type, renames the node "[GHOST]<last word of the type>" and keeps nodeData in ghostData.

nodeData.desc: Saved data of the original node.
